TERMS OF SERVICE
By buying an avatar, you agree to these terms.

1. BUYING
• You must be 13 or older, or have a parent's permission.
• Avatars are sold as shown in the pictures and description. Ask before buying if you're unsure about anything.
• Avatars marked as one copy are sold to one buyer only and won't be sold again.

2. PAYMENT
• Full payment is due before the files are delivered.
• Prices are in the currency shown on this page. Payment fees are paid by the buyer.
• A Reserved avatar is held for 48 hours. If it isn't paid for by then, it goes back on sale.

3. BASES AND ASSETS
• If an avatar uses a paid base or paid assets, you must own a license for them before I send the files. I may ask for proof of purchase.
• Every base and asset creator's terms still apply to you.

4. REFUNDS
• Avatars are digital goods, so there are no refunds once the files are delivered.
• If a file is broken or missing, tell me within 7 days and I'll fix it.

5. YOUR RIGHTS
• You may upload and use the avatar on your own VRChat account(s).
• Uploads must stay PRIVATE unless we agree otherwise in writing, and public uploads must also be allowed by every base and asset license.
• You may edit the avatar for your own use, as long as the base's license allows it.
• You may NOT resell, share, give away, leak or redistribute the files or any parts of them.
• Credit is appreciated, e.g. 'Avatar by Deltro' in your bio.

6. MY RIGHTS
• I keep the rights to my own original work, such as custom textures and models I made.
• I may keep showing pictures of the avatar in my shop and portfolio.

7. BREAKING THESE TERMS
If you leak, resell or share files, or break a base's license, I'll stop selling to you, may report it to the platform, and you won't get a refund.

I may update these terms. The version on this page when you buy is the one that applies to your purchase.
